zh.title: 杜拜國際機場（DXB）2026上半年旅客量跌逾三成
zh.summary: 杜拜國際機場2026年上半年因衝突導致旅客量下降超過三成
body: 杜拜國際機場在2026年上半年錄得旅客數量大幅減少，機場營運商將此下滑歸因於破壞區域航空旅行的軍事衝突。營運杜拜國際機場與阿勒馬克圖姆國際機場（DWC）的杜拜機場公司（Dubai Airports）於2026年8月26日表示，2026年上半年對該公司而言是一段充滿挑戰的時期。
在2026年1月至6月期間，杜拜國際機場共接待了3,150萬人次的旅客，與2025年同期相比下降了31.3%。該機場的起降架次在今年上半年總計為150,600架次，年減32.1%；與此同時，貨運量在上半年達到751,340噸，同比下降了28.7%。
此次營運下滑的主因為美國、以色列與伊朗之間於2026年2月28日爆發的軍事衝突，該衝突使中東及灣區陷入動盪。由於伊朗向該地區國家（包括杜拜）發射了飛彈與無人機，出於安全考量，許多航空公司選擇繞道避開該區域。
儘管上半年面臨挑戰，杜拜機場公司執行長保羅·格里菲斯（Paul Griffiths）強調，隨著旅客信心增強和人數回升，情況正在改善。格里菲斯指出，上半年的形勢考驗了航空系統的各個環節，但隨著運能穩步恢復，需求隨即做出反應。在第二季度中，旅客量逐月增長，從2026年4月的350萬人次增加到5月的450萬人次，並在6月達到500萬人次。
展望未來，杜拜機場公司發言人預期下半年將迎來更強勁的成長動能。這得益於航空公司網路與航次頻率的持續恢復、國際轉機旅客量的增長、主要客源市場旅遊警示的放寬、冬季班表，以及杜拜即將舉辦的一系列全球商業、休閒和體育賽事。作為對比，杜拜國際機場在2025年共接待了創紀錄的9,520萬名旅客，創下該機場歷史上最繁忙的一年，也是全球所有機場中有史以來最高的年度國際旅客吞吐量。

en.title: Dubai International Airport (DXB) Passenger Traffic Falls Over 31% in First Half of 2026
en.summary: Dubai International Airport passenger traffic dropped 31.3% in first half of 2026 amid regional conflict.
body: Dubai International Airport recorded a significant decrease in its passenger numbers during the first half of 2026, with airport operators attributing the decline to ongoing regional military conflicts that have disrupted air travel. According to Dubai Airports, which manages both Dubai International and Al Maktoum International (DWC), the first six months of 2026 represented a challenging period for aviation operations in the region.

From January to June 2026, Dubai International welcomed 31.5 million passengers, marking a 31.3% decline compared to the corresponding period in 2025. Flight movements at the airport also experienced a downturn, totaling 150,600 aircraft movements during the six-month period, which is a 32.1% reduction year-on-year. Furthermore, cargo volumes handled at the hub decreased by 28.7% year-on-year to 751,340 tons.

The operational decline followed the outbreak of a military conflict involving the United States, Israel, and Iran on February 28, 2026, which impacted the Middle East and Gulf regions. Iran launched missiles and unmanned aerial vehicles against regional targets, including Dubai. Consequently, multiple international airlines opted to bypass the airspace in the area to minimize risks.

Despite the challenging start to the year, Dubai Airports CEO Paul Griffiths emphasized that the situation has begun to stabilize. Griffiths stated that the first half of the year tested the entire aviation ecosystem, but demand has responded quickly as capacity returns. Passenger numbers showed a steady month-on-month increase throughout the second quarter, rising from 3.5 million in April 2026 to 4.5 million in May, and reaching 5 million in June.

Looking ahead, Dubai Airports expressed optimism for the remaining half of 2026. A spokesperson noted that momentum is expected to build due to the recovery of airline networks, an increase in international transit traffic, the winter flight schedule, and Dubai's schedule of business, leisure, and sporting events. In 2025, Dubai International handled a record-breaking 95.2 million guests, which was the highest annual international passenger volume recorded by any airport.

zh.title: 南美航空融資引進11架新機 2026年底機隊突破410架
zh.summary: 南美航空獲5.05億美元融資，年底前引進11架空中巴士與巴西航空工業客機。
body: 南美航空集團（LATAM Airlines Group）宣布將在2026年底前接收11架新世代窄體客機，以推進機隊現代化進程。本次公布的機隊擴增與更新計畫涵蓋空中巴士（Airbus）與巴西航空工業（Embraer）製造的機型，並獲得總額達5.05億美元的長期融資支持。
在最新一批交付規劃中，南美航空預計接收1架空中巴士A320neo、4架空中巴士A321neo，以及6架巴西航空工業E195-E2客機。引進E195-E2對該集團的巴西營運具有重要意義，南美航空計畫於未來數月內將該機型投入巴西國內航線，這將是該機型首次進入巴西國內航網服務。
本次由法國巴黎銀行（BNP Paribas）主導的5.05億美元融資案中，約有4億美元採用永續連結融資結構。根據該機制，融資利率與南美航空每單位二氧化碳排放強度的減排表現直接掛鉤。南美航空設定目標在2030年前將碳排放強度相較2019年基準降低6%，並朝向2050年實現淨零碳排放的長期目標邁進。
南美航空在2026年前七個月已接收13架新機，包括7架空中巴士A320neo、4架空中巴士A321neo及2架波音（Boeing）787-9客機。加上本次公布的11架引進計畫，該集團預計2026全年新機接收總量將突破40架，並使機隊總規模在2026年底前超過410架。
展望長期營運規劃，南美航空預計在2030年前累計新增多達130架新世代客機，屆時機隊中將有超過半數為新世代機型。此外，該集團首架長程空中巴士A321XLR客機預計於2027年投入服務，機上商務艙將配備Thompson Aero Seating VantageSOLO全平躺座椅。

en.title: LATAM Secures $505M Financing to Add 11 Aircraft by Year-End 2026
en.summary: LATAM Airlines secures $505 million financing to add 11 Airbus and Embraer aircraft by late 2026.
body: LATAM Airlines Group is expanding its fleet with the addition of 11 next-generation narrowbody aircraft before the end of 2026. The latest fleet renewal package includes aircraft manufactured by Airbus and Embraer, supported by a total of $505 million in long-term financing secured by the airline group.

Under the newly announced tranche, LATAM expects to take delivery of one Airbus A320neo, four Airbus A321neos, and six Embraer E195-E2s. The addition of the Embraer E195-E2s is particularly strategic for the group's Brazilian operations, as LATAM plans to introduce the type on domestic routes in Brazil in the coming months, marking its first operation of the model in the country's domestic network.

The financing structure led by BNP Paribas includes approximately $400 million tied to sustainability-linked metrics. Under this mechanism, LATAM's loan interest rates are linked directly to its carbon dioxide emissions intensity performance, providing financial incentives for the airline to meet its target of reducing emissions intensity by 6% by 2030 compared to a 2019 baseline, ahead of its longer-term goal of reaching net-zero emissions by 2050.

Having already taken delivery of 13 aircraft during the first seven months of 2026—comprising seven Airbus A320neos, four A321neos, and two Boeing 787-9 Dreamliners—LATAM projects total new aircraft deliveries to exceed 40 units for the full year. As a result, the airline group anticipates ending 2026 with an active fleet count exceeding 410 aircraft.

Looking further ahead, LATAM plans to add as many as 130 next-generation aircraft to its fleet by 2030, which would result in more than half of its total fleet consisting of modern, lower-emission airframes. Additionally, the group is scheduled to introduce its first long-range Airbus A321XLR in 2027, featuring Thompson Aero Seating VantageSOLO full-flat seats in its Premium Business cabin.
